Investor Opportunity: 2813 10th St, Niagara Falls, NY 14305

Tenant-occupied single-family home delivering immediate cash flow with seamless owner-occupier flexibility in Niagara Falls’ affordable North End market.This classic 1935-built, 965 sq ft residence sits on a manageable 3,485 sq ft lot and features 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom plus a 1-car garage. It’s currently tenant-occupied, giving you instant rental income while keeping the door wide open for personal use.

Flexible investment strategies include:Turnkey Cash-Flow Rental — Tenant already in place means immediate monthly income with minimal vacancy risk. Proven rental demand in this price-sensitive Niagara Falls pocket makes it a low-effort, steady performer right out of the gate.
Owner-Occupier Purchase — Buy subject to the existing tenancy or work with the tenant for a smooth transition to make it your primary residence — an affordable way to own in a location with strong long-term appreciation tied to tourism and local revitalization.
Value-Add / Hybrid Play — Light cosmetic updates can quickly increase rents or equity, positioning the property for higher yields or a future resale while collecting income along the way.

Why this property stands out for investors:Compact, easy-to-manage single-family layout ideal for families or stable long-term tenants.
Ultra-affordable entry point with a 1-car garage and fenced yard keeping ongoing costs low.
Prime Niagara Falls location near attractions, amenities, and transportation — benefiting from year-round tourism spillover and residential demand.

Whether your goal is passive rental income from day one with the tenant already paying or an easy path to owner-occupier ownership at a realistic price, 2813 10th Street gives you the best of both worlds — immediate cash flow, low maintenance, and clear upside potential.Ready to review tenant details, run the numbers, or discuss comps?
